```{r load packages, include=F}
##load packages
#library(tinytex)
#library(shiny)
#library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
#library(lubridate)
#library(knitr)
#library(cowplot)

```

```{r wq data, include=F}
metadata <- read.csv("wqp_ncrnwater_metadata.csv")
metadata <- metadata %>%
  tidyr::separate(SiteCode, c("Network", "Park", "Site"))

park <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Park==params$Park & Site==params$Site)
  # dplyr::filter(Park=="NACE", Site=="OXRU")
mypark <- unique(park$LongName)
mysite <- unique(park$SiteName)

thresholds <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(SiteCodeWQX, DataName, LowerPoint, UpperPoint)

colnames(thresholds) <- c("MonitoringLocationIdentifier", "CharacteristicName", "LowerPoint", "UpperPoint")

##loading in data
wq_data <- read.csv("wqp.csv")

##selecting columns
wq_data1 <- wq_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ActivityStartDate, MonitoringLocationIdentifier,
         MonitoringLocationName, CharacteristicName, 
         ResultMeasureValue, ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode)

##converting date to date object
wq_data1$ActivityStartDate <- as.Date(wq_data1$ActivityStartDate, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
##extracting year
wq_data1$sample_year <- lubridate::year(wq_data1$ActivityStartDate)

##converting ResultMeasureValue to numeric object
wq_data1$ResultMeasureValue <- as.numeric(wq_data1$ResultMeasureValue)

wq_data1 <- wq_data1 %>%
  na.omit()

wq_data_merged <- merge(wq_data1, thresholds,
                        by=c("MonitoringLocationIdentifier", 
                             "CharacteristicName"), all=T)

##data wrangling
wq_data2 <- wq_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(CharacteristicName %in% c("Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)",
                                   "Total Nitrogen, mixed forms",
                                   "Total Phosphorus, mixed forms",
                                   "pH", "Dissolved oxygen (DO)",
                                   "Salinity", "Temperature, water")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_year>2018) %>%
  tidyr::separate(MonitoringLocationIdentifier, c("Network", "Park", "Site")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ActivityStartDate, Park, Site, MonitoringLocationName, CharacteristicName, ResultMeasureValue, ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode, sample_year, LowerPoint, UpperPoint) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(karst=case_when(Park=="ANTI" | Park=="HAFE" | Park=="MONO" ~ "karst",
                         Park!="ANTI" | Park!="HAFE" | Park!="MONO" ~ "non-karst")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(nutrient_ecoregion=case_when(Park=="ANTI" | Park=="CATO" | Park=="HAFE" ~ "XI",
                                      Park!="ANTI" | Park!="CATO" | Park!="HAFE" ~ "IX")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cold_water=case_when(Park=="CATO" ~ "cold",
                              Park!="CATO" ~ "warm")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pass_fail=case_when(ResultMeasureValue>UpperPoint~"F",
                             ResultMeasureValue<LowerPoint~"F",
                             TRUE~"P")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode=case_when(ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode=="deg C"~"\u00B0C",
                                                 ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode!="deg C"~ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(UpperPoint=as.character(UpperPoint)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(UpperPoint=case_when(CharacteristicName=="pH"~"9",
                              CharacteristicName!="pH"~UpperPoint)) %>%
  dplyr::select(ActivityStartDate, Park, Site, MonitoringLocationName, karst, nutrient_ecoregion, cold_water, CharacteristicName, ResultMeasureValue, ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode, sample_year, LowerPoint, UpperPoint, pass_fail)

##changing column names
colnames(wq_data2) <- c("Date", "Park", "Site", "SiteName","karst", 
                        "nutrient_ecoregion", "cold_water",
                        "CharacteristicName", "ResultMeasureValue", 
                        "unit", "sample_year", "LowerPoint","UpperPoint",
                        "pass_fail")

```

```{r park wq data, include=F}
##filtering data frame by parameters
park_data <- wq_data2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Park==params$Park, Site==params$Site)

# park_data <- wq_data2 %>%
#   dplyr::filter(Park=="NACE", Site=="OXRU")

##2024 data
park_data_24 <- park_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_year==2024) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site, CharacteristicName) %>%
  ##calculating percent pass
  dplyr::mutate(percent_pass=(sum(pass_fail=="P")/sum(pass_fail=="P" | pass_fail=="F"))*100) %>%
  ##adding minimum and maximum value columns
  dplyr::mutate(min=min(ResultMeasureValue),
         max=max(ResultMeasureValue)) %>%
  ##rounding to two decimal places in min and max columns
  dplyr::mutate(min=round(min, digits=2),
         max=round(max, digits=2)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site, cold_water, karst, nutrient_ecoregion, CharacteristicName, unit, LowerPoint, UpperPoint, min, max, pass_fail, percent_pass) %>%
  dplyr::summarize()

##function to remove duplicate rows for parameters with both passing and failing values 
for(i in unique(park_data_24$CharacteristicName)) {
  if(nrow(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName==i,])==2) {
    park_data_24 <- park_data_24[!(park_data_24$CharacteristicName==i &
                                     park_data_24$pass_fail=="P"),]
  } else{park_data_24 <- park_data_24}
}

##2019-23 data
park_data_19_23 <- park_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_year!=2024) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site, CharacteristicName) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent_pass=(sum(pass_fail=="P")/sum(pass_fail=="P" | pass_fail=="F"))*100) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site, CharacteristicName, percent_pass) %>%
  dplyr::summarize()

```

<!--setting up data frame for table and figures-->
```{r table df, include=F}
##merging 2024 and 2019-23 data frames 
table <- merge(park_data_24, park_data_19_23, by="CharacteristicName")

##creating data frame for table
table <- table %>%
  dplyr::select(CharacteristicName, percent_pass.x, percent_pass.y) %>%
  ##rounding percent pass to two decimal places
  dplyr::mutate(percent_pass.x=round(percent_pass.x, digits=0)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent_pass.y=round(percent_pass.y, digits=0)) 

table2 <- table %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!(CharacteristicName), names_to="years", values_to="percent_pass") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(years=case_when(years=="percent_pass.x"~"2024",
                         years=="percent_pass.y"~"2019–23")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(colors=case_when(percent_pass==100~"black",
                          percent_pass!=100~"#E32636")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x_pos=case_when(CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)"~1,
                         CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)"~2,
                         CharacteristicName=="pH"~3,
                         CharacteristicName=="Salinity"~4,
                         CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms"~5,
                         CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms"~6,
                         CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water"~7)) %>%
  dplyr::select(CharacteristicName, x_pos, years, percent_pass, colors)

colnames(table2) = c("Parameter", "x_pos", "years", "percent_pass", "colors")

colors_list <- table2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Parameter, colors, years) %>%
  dplyr::summarize() 

colors_list <- colors_list[!colors_list$years=="2019–23",]

colors_list$Parameter=c("Acid neutralizing capacity", "Dissolved oxygen",
                        "Salinity", "Water temperature", "Total nitrogen",
                        "Total phosphorus", "PH")

colors_list <- colors_list[order(colors_list$Parameter),]

colors_list <- print(colors_list$colors)

```

<!--creating figure-->
```{r figure, echo=F, warning=F}
##creating bar graph
bar_graph <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data=table2, aes(x=as.factor(x_pos), y=percent_pass, fill=years),
           width=0.7, color="black", size=0.8, position="dodge", stat="identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Years", values=c("gray85", "#8DA0CB")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("Acid\nneutralizing\ncapacity", "Dissolved\noxygen", "pH",
                             "Salinity", "Total\nnitrogen", "Total\nphosphorus", "Water\ntemperature")) +
  xlab("Parameter") +
  ylab("% Passing") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0.3, 7.6), ylim=c(0, 110), expand=F) +
  geom_text(data=table2, aes(x=as.factor(x_pos), y=percent_pass + 3.5, group=years, label=percent_pass, color=colors),
            position=position_dodge2(width=0.7, preserve="total"), size=3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#E32636", "black"), guide="none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(color=colors_list, size=9, angle=35, vjust=0.8, hjust=0.5),
        axis.title.x=element_text(vjust=3, size=12),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=12),
        legend.position=c(0.8, -0.23),
        legend.direction="horizontal",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.2,0.2,0.2,0.2), "cm"))

#bar_graph

```

<!--function for adding icons to parameters with exceedances-->
```{r icons, include=F}
##creating function to print icons
icon <- function(df) {

  if (df$pass_fail=="F") {
    #"!"
    knitr::asis_output("\U2666")
    } else{" "} #else{print(" ")}

}

```

```{r, echo=F, out.width="120%"}
bar_graph

```

Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC) \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)",])`}}        
**Acceptable values:** Above `r park_data_24$LowerPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)"]`   
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Acid Neutralizing Capacity (ANC)"]`  
ANC is a measure of water’s ability to buffer acidic inputs. ANC measurements have never fallen below the acceptable threshold since monitoring began in 2005.  
   
Dissolved Oxygen (DO) \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)",])`}}    
**Acceptable values:** Above `r park_data_24$LowerPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)"]`  
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Dissolved oxygen (DO)"]`   
Aquatic organisms rely on DO to survive. Cooler water holds more DO, so measurements vary by season. DO has not fallen below the acceptable threshold since 2006.  
  
pH \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="pH",])`}}    
**Acceptable range:** `r park_data_24$LowerPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="pH"]` – `r park_data_24$UpperPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="pH"]`    
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="pH"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="pH"]`  
pH is a measure of how acidic or basic a liquid is.  pH measurements have fallen within the acceptable range since monitoring began in 2005.  
  
Salinity \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Salinity",])`}}    
**Acceptable values:** Below `r park_data_24$UpperPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Salinity"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Salinity"]`  
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Salinity"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Salinity"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Salinity"]`  
Road salt is the main cause of high salinity in NCR streams.  Salinity has not surpassed the acceptable threshold at Flowing Springs Run since 2017.  
  
Total Nitrogen \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms",])`}}   
**Acceptable values:** Below `r park_data_24$UpperPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms"]`  
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Nitrogen, mixed forms"]`  
Nitrogen is commonly used in agricultural fertilizers. Under high concentrations, it can adversely affect aquatic life. All total nitrogen measurements since 2016 have exceeded the acceptable threshold.

Total Phosphorus \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms",])`}}   
**Acceptable values:** Below `r park_data_24$UpperPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms"]`  
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Total Phosphorus, mixed forms"]`  
Phosphorus is often a limiting nutrient in freshwater streams, meaning a small increase in phosphorus concentration can lead to algal blooms. All observations in 2024 exceeded the threshold.  
  
Water Temperature \textbf{\textcolor{red}{`r icon(park_data_24[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water",])`}}    
**Acceptable values:** Below `r park_data_24$UpperPoint[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water"]`  
**2024 range:** `r park_data_24$min[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water"]` – `r park_data_24$max[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water"]` `r park_data_24$unit[park_data_24$CharacteristicName=="Temperature, water"]`   
Water temperature measurements have remained below the acceptable threshold since monitoring began in 2005.
